name: Waterspeed
note: Official Technology Supplier of the NorthStar SailGP Team in a multi-year partnership (SailGP press release, 27 Nov 2025; waterspeedapp.com/northstar-sailgp). Ownership not sourced yet: the company behind the app is Waterspeed Technologies Limited, with its registered office in Dubai International Financial Centre, Dubai (its own site footer, 2025) - a registered seat identifies the legal entity, not the owner. Its CEO is Costantino Spagnoletti (partnership page). No page naming Waterspeed's owner or shareholders could be opened and quoted.
